editorNotes.purpose: First real question-type bank for Level 1 Stage 1; covers the approved vocabulary-in-context allocation only, not the complete stage bank.
editorNotes.reviewNotes: Original Grade 3 vocabulary items. Requires editorial and pedagogical review before approval or publication. Explore items use sentence-level context; Extend items are intended for application within whole-book study but are not tied to an adopted novel.

questions.prompt: Mira was eager to open the parcel. What does eager mean?

source.reference: Newly authored English Aptitude vocabulary-in-context item for Level 1, Stage 1.

rights.basis: Original prompt and options authored for this project.

feedback.incorrect: Reread the sentence and use its clues to work out the word's meaning.

questions.explanation: Eager means keen or excited to do something.
